summary: A Faultline demo payments service built with Spring Boot, processing payment requests via REST and Kafka, with PostgreSQL persistence.

modules.name: payment
modules.purpose: Handles payment processing, events, merchant balance, and provider integration.

entryPoints.name: POST /payments
entryPoints.purpose: Receive payment requests and publish them to Kafka.

entryPoints.name: kafka payments.requested
entryPoints.purpose: Process inbound payment messages from Kafka.

entryPoints.name: kafka payments.retry
entryPoints.purpose: Retry processing failed payment messages from Kafka.

journeys.name: process-payment
journeys.description: End to end flow for receiving and processing a payment request.

steps.does: Receive payment request and send to Kafka.
Consume payment request from Kafka and pass to service.
Process payment transaction and persist updates.
